items.headline: Baleba makes first appearance in behind-closed-doors friendly
items.summary: Carlos Baleba played his first minutes for Manchester United in a behind-closed-doors match against Lausanne-Sport on Friday as he recovers from an ankle injury.

items.headline: Man Utd threaten legal action over JJ Gabriel departure
items.summary: Manchester United prepared to take legal action if 15-year-old academy sensation JJ Gabriel completes a transfer away from the club after he requested de-registration.

items.headline: AC Milan targets Leny Yoro in potential €62m deal
items.summary: AC Milan manager Ruben Amorim targets centre-back Leny Yoro, who has had a difficult two years at Old Trafford since his €62m move from Lille.

items.headline: Adrien Truffert signals openness to Manchester United move
items.summary: Bournemouth left-back Adrien Truffert confirms he is ready for a move, with Manchester United linked at around £60m as potential summer 2027 target.
